title: The effect of the MLB pitch clock
text:
The introduction of the MLB pitch clock was perhaps the most drastic and immediate rule change baseball had seen in decades. The rule change happened after the 2022 baseball season so the first season that had the pitch clock was 2023. The clock fundamentally altered the game’s famous slow cadence. Players, long accustomed to leisurely pacing and endless adjustments on the mound, were now forced into constant motion, transforming a sport once defined by patience into one defined by urgency. This single device, ticking down the seconds, did what years of debate could not: LIST THE PROBLEMS THAT I AM ADDRESSING WITH MY GRAPHS.
